title: Five Weapons
description: Five experimental weapon types in one isolated range, second pass after the owner's playtest: Foundry (heavy hand cannon), Sightline (scout rifle), Switchback (automatic carbine), Bulkhead (scattergun, two variants: Breacher and Sweeper) and Mass Driver (charged kinetic). Condi's SigmAudio sounds. Keys 1-5 switch, 3 and 4 again swap variants, hold RMB (or V) to aim Sightline, Switchback and Mass Driver; 6 is Heavy Report as you played it, 0 the Static Pulse. A 55 m lane behind the mark. No enemies. Offline: nothing of yours is saved or changed.
limitations: Guns are placeholder shapes; Arty's models and layered Glyph effects are not wired yet.
Sounds are Condi's SigmAudio candidates (not approved). N turns all weapon sound off.
Aiming down the sights is on RMB only while no Echo holds RMB; V or a mouse side button always aims.
